tara (PM): Quick sync — customers pushed a few telemetry asks that we need to triage for the console roadmap: per-route cost breakdown, latency heatmaps, trace sampling controls, and error attribution tied to prompt sets. Can we scope?

mike (Eng): Thanks. Rough thoughts: cost-by-route is mostly aggregation + a join to routing metadata. Heatmaps are UI + histogram infra. Trace sampling controls are trickier (sampling in dataplane + metadata).

sasha (CS): From Customer A: "We need to show cost per feature (route) so finance can map spend to product teams." Also Customer B wants error traces grouped by prompt template.

ali (SRE): For trace sampling: we can add route tags to traces today, but dynamic sampling per-route requires a small hook in the agent/runtime. Risk: increased index cardinality in tracing backend.

rachael (Data): Export to BI (CSV/BigQuery) is a common ask — we can add a daily job that materializes cost_by_route and error_by_template tables for customers on Dedicated/Private. Hosted will need permission gating.

mike (Eng): Proposal for MVP (3 sprints): 1) Aggregated cost_by_route metrics + UI table, 2) Latency histogram/heatmap per route (sampled), 3) Error attribution surface (group by error type + prompt template) with links to traces. Keep dynamic sampling out of MVP — offer a config flag for dedicated customers as opt-in.

tara (PM): Acceptance criteria for MVP: - per-route cost visible in console for last 7/30/90 days - latency heatmap with p50/p90/p99 toggles - error surface that links to 1 trace at minimum for each error bucket - export button for CSV. Anything missing?

ali (SRE): Privacy note: prompt template grouping must not surface raw PII. Need a scrubber on prompt templates before storing/sharing. Add to definition-of-done.

rachael (Data): For exports include model_id, route_id, customer_project_id, cost_usd, tokens_in/out, latency_ms, error_code, template_id. We'll provide a schema.

mike (Eng): Rough capacity/effort: cost_by_route aggregation: 2w infra + 1w UI. Heatmaps: 2w infra + 2w UI. Error attribution: 1w backend + 1w UI. Total ~9 engineer-weeks across teams.

tara (PM): Prioritization ask: which parts can unblock customers quickly? I propose landing cost_by_route + CSV export first (fast ROI), then heatmaps, then error attribution.

sasha (CS): Customer A will accept early access to cost_by_route CSV — good win. Customer B insists on error grouping but can wait for alpha.

ali (SRE): I'll draft the tracing hook changes and scrubber spec. Concern: if we add high-cardinality tags (prompt_template_id) we need TTL and sampling rules. Will propose default LRU+TTL.

infra-bot: CI pipeline: telemetry-agg branch build passed — link: https://ci.redwood/telemetry-agg/34 :white_check_mark:

mike (Eng): Follow-ups: create RFC for data model + UI wireframes. I'll pair with rachaelel for export schema.

tara (PM): Action items: - mike: RFC + wireframes by Wed (1717080000) - ali: tracing hook + scrubber spec by Fri - rachael: export schema + sample table by Thu - sasha: confirm customer alpha participants. We'll slot cost_by_route into next sprint if RFC looks good.

sasha (CS): Will confirm Customer A for alpha and ping legal re: export gating.

tara (PM): Great. If no blockers I'll add to roadmap board and flag as "customer-driven". Meeting to review RFC Tue 10am.

mike (Eng): noted. I'll drop a short prototype query we can use for the heatmap: ```SELECT route_id, bucket_latency_ms, count(*) FROM requests WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2;```

ali (SRE): Also adding a short runbook note: if trace backend errors spike after enabling template_id tag, roll back via feature flag and scale the tracer indexers.

tara (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll create the tracker card and assign owners.

sasha (CS): :thumbsup:

tara (PM): tagging FYI @eng-platform and @security for scrubber review.
